name: Unassuming Guise
body:
School illusion (glamer) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a scrap of dirty cloth)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will (see text); Spell Resistance no

When you cast this spell you take on the appearance of a completely average member of whatever race is the majority of the current settlement. You gain a +10 bonus to disguise checks to impersonate a common member of this race. In addition, if someone attempts to recall information about you that creature must attempt a Will save to remember anything beyond a very simple physical description of the disguise.
